body:
At copper clearance .25 mm and displayed edge clearance .55 mm, `place_pose` accepted the published Y1 candidate as legal even though two pads have only .50 mm clearance. The resolved edge floor now reaches placement grading, which reports both .05 mm shortfalls and refuses newly introduced violations atomically. Improving inherited defects still supports `no_worse:true, legal:false`; direct poses, arbitrary rotations and coordinated moves remain available.

Closes #964

Closes #967

Both issues are configured to close automatically when this PR merges, as requested. The bounded implementation scope and remaining acceptance work are documented below.

The implementation also prevents complete-legality claims when geometry or declarations are unmeasured: chamfer/padstack simplifications, extra open Edge.Cuts, unequal-axis circles and unevaluated custom edge rules are explicitly disclosed. Exact rectangular edge measurements retain near-cardinal pad tilt. Invalid edge values and unreadable/unsupported custom-rule containers cannot certify strict legality. Requested/resolved scalar values, declared custom rules, measured gaps, physical containment and pad-pair clearance remain separate.

Independent operations review additionally fixed strict near search selecting unclean candidates and two output hazards. Output-only requirement siblings now cause a refusal before publication; late write errors restore prior board/project/rule/brief files. Failed restoration is reported as partial mutation with recovery backups, rather than falsely claiming nothing changed. Normal no-worse search and supported direct multi-part poses remain intact.

Validation is pinned to final head **cbc819b6b862f6ec14ecb30b8659819e800fce76**, whose production and test trees match behavior-tested **ad156f2a2cc1b6f58eafc25abfeb0a6c31a811d4**. All three reviewers independently checked this documentation-only publication identity.

- [Three independent bug-review reports and evidence](https://github.com/edgehero/KiCadRoutingTools/blob/cbc819b6b862f6ec14ecb30b8659819e800fce76/docs/issue-964-evidence/three-reviewers/README.md): geometry, operations and rules reviewers independently found seven bug groups despite the existing tests passing. The corrected candidate passed **61 placement CLI calls, four independent DRC commands and four direct API invalid-floor checks**. Native KiCad readbacks establish geometry, written poses and mechanical preservation; declaration identities and fixed footprint blocks are checked. Real Windows read-only output failure and an injected restoration denial verify recovery and truthful partial-write reporting. No unresolved discrepancy remains in the exercised scope.
- Geometry boundaries include 0/.5/1/1.0001/89.5/90/90.5/179.5/180.5/359.5 degrees, oval/roundrect positive controls and an unequal-axis native circle. Strict refusals identify the measured violation or missing coverage; ordinary inherited dirty writes remain explicitly unclean.
- Rules checks include finite zero/positive controls, NaN/infinity/negative declarations, valid copper-only rules, malformed containers, quoted names/comments, and ordinary versus strict in-place operations. Strict near, direct multi-part moves, atomic in-place refusal and all three requirement-sibling types are exercised.
- Focused regressions: **14 files passed**, native text/live geometry parity passed, both routing parity gates passed, static hygiene passed all nine checks and 1108 mutation anchors. Documentation examples: 32 runnable blocks passed, 78 fragments skipped. The optional untracked perturbed-tigard subtest is absent; its containing file's remaining assertions passed.
- [Earlier reproduction and first final verification](https://github.com/edgehero/KiCadRoutingTools/blob/cbc819b6b862f6ec14ecb30b8659819e800fce76/docs/issue-964-evidence/README.md) retain exact original actor replay, public bad/control fixtures, baseline/brief/project identities, native measurements, and 53 CLI checks of predecessor `64c6368b`. Those historical counts are not represented as new runs on the final revision.

Remaining acceptance work:

- A common placement/final-DRC effective-rule policy: defaults, project-floor overrides, fabrication/severity handling, and effective per-pad custom edge-rule evaluation. Explicit .50 on a .60 project still resolves differently in placement and DRC; matching flags alone is insufficient.
- Exact native complex/custom/chamfer/padstack/curved geometry and a full custom-rule parser. A valid rule name consisting solely of a parenthesis conservatively reports incomplete because the legacy parser loses quote identity. Staged after-report rule-source paths can be temporary; input/output declaration identities remain preserved.
- #964's other channels: routing-writer requirement siblings, score/baseline coverage, stale withheld-budget recovery, mechanical requirements/conflicts, and artifact authorship manifests.

No full native board DRC, full-suite result, routed connectivity/quality, body/height certification, crash-safe/concurrent filesystem transactions or model-performance gain is claimed. Alternate seed/optimize/reconstruct checks in the earlier evidence exercise inherited/no-op geometry and output reporting, not every search candidate. No skill or instruction variants changed. Original fixtures, public baseline and unrelated user changes were preserved. Neither issue is manually closed; the PR is not merged.
title: Placement: enforce edge requirements and preserve graded output
